memoryBuilder.verseText: God gives wisdom. It comes from Him.

sequence.prompt: What happened when Solomon became king? Put it in order.

items.label: Solomon asked for a listening heart
He found the baby's real mother

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Knowing what is right and doing it
We ask God, and He gives it

application.question: Solomon asked to be the right kind of person, not to have more things. What could you ask God for today?
application.followUp: God did not give Solomon wisdom because Solomon was clever. He gave it because Solomon asked. God gives wisdom to anyone who asks Him — including you.
